function.arguments: {"message":"Hi! When an import only partially succeeds, the main screen won’t show why some rows were skipped. After the import finishes, go to **Settings → Data → Import history**, click the run you just did, and you’ll see a per‑row list with a reason for every row that didn’t import (e.g. missing required field, malformed email, duplicate, etc.). Fix those rows and re‑run the import on just the flagged rows – that way you won’t re‑process the ones that already succeeded. arguments.message: Hi! When an import only partially succeeds, the main screen won’t show why some rows were skipped. After the import finishes, go to **Settings → Data → Import history**, click the run you just did, and you’ll see a per‑row list with a reason for every row that didn’t import (e.g. missing required field, malformed email, duplicate, etc.). Fix those rows and re‑run the import on just the flagged rows – that way you won’t re‑process the ones that already succeeded. If you need help finding the history tab or interpreting the reasons, let me know!
